claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destination_plane_binding
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing activated magic-item + charge-pool family fits the recharge and spellcasting shell, but it cannot express that each cast of Gate or Plane Shift is constrained to the plane keyed to the pressed side of the cube. Omitting that field would broaden the item into unrestricted casts of those spells and produce a misleading trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side." / "Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_cubic_gate.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
